formula: For q=2^d with odd d, f(0)=f(1)=1 and f(x)=1/(x+x^-1) otherwise; row r and column c receive group h=r*f(c*r) and pair bit Tr(c*h).
claim_boundary: The finite cases are regression evidence only. General existence follows only from the symbolic inverse-pair, permutation, margin, and Kloosterman-bound proof.
